items.a: InnoTrans takes place from 22 to 25 September 2026 at Expo Center Berlin, 14055 Berlin.
InnoTrans is a trade visitors only fair. Check the official visitor information for the current access and ticket details.

items.q: What are the InnoTrans 2026 opening hours?
items.a: The official hours are 09:00 to 18:00 from 22 to 24 September, and 09:00 to 16:00 on Friday 25 September.

items.q: What should I do after InnoTrans closes?
items.a: Pick one area based on your energy and exit time. City West is the simplest after a long day; Kulturforum/Potsdamer Platz works with a planned dinner or event; and the historic centre is better after an early finish or Friday's shorter day.

items.q: Can I fit sightseeing around InnoTrans?
items.a: Yes, but give the fair and sightseeing separate blocks. A 2-hour historic-centre walking tour can work in a genuine daytime gap, while a long fair day is better followed by one short evening area.
